rows.name: autopilot stall
rows.summary: Runs the durable stall saga for a PRD, including hold move, defer record, and reset.

rows.name: autopilot park
rows.summary: Consumes or reconciles a park request and applies the systemic-park breaker.

rows.name: autopilot reset-prd
rows.summary: Atomically clears per-PRD state and restores build counters and phase markers.

rows.name: autopilot defer
rows.summary: Appends one JSON object to a batch deferred ledger with PRD attribution.

rows.name: autopilot check-plan
rows.summary: Reads the task snapshot and returns a distinct failure when its count exceeds the loop ceiling.

rows.name: autopilot select
rows.summary: Selects deterministically from wip then backlog while excluding hold, returning JSON even when drained.

rows.name: autopilot frontmatter
rows.summary: Parses PRD controls, warns on defaults, and transactionally applies the derived state fields.

rows.name: autopilot phase-done
rows.summary: Applies one named workflow outcome from the current phase as an atomic transition.

rows.name: autopilot resume-target
rows.summary: Returns the authoritative resume target after schema-version preflight.

rows.name: autopilot render audit
rows.summary: Renders the per-PRD decision audit from state arrays into the repository review directory.

rows.name: autopilot render report
rows.summary: Creates or updates batch report PRD, stalled, or summary sections from state and metrics.

rows.name: autopilot render metrics
rows.summary: Prints a deterministic Markdown summary of loop metrics rows.

rows.name: statectl complete-prd
rows.summary: Appends a computed completed-PRD batch summary and resets consecutive parks.

rows.name: deferred ledger root
rows.summary: Per-batch durable deferred object containing batch_id and ordered items.

rows.name: deferred ledger items[]
rows.summary: Caller record copied with prd attribution; op_id deduplicates retrying stall appends.

rows.name: park-requested marker
rows.summary: JSON handoff carrying prd and reason for the next session's durable park saga.

rows.name: _AUTOPILOT_CLI_FAILPOINT
rows.summary: Test-only durable-saga interruption selector for named stall/park boundaries.

rows.name: reports batch state final
rows.summary: Drained state archived as reports/{batch}-state-final.json before post-drain actions.

rows.name: reports batch report
rows.summary: Durable batch Markdown report with replaceable per-PRD sections, stalled records, and final summary.

rows.name: per-PRD audit report
rows.summary: Durable review-directory Markdown projection of autonomous, deferred, and doubt decision arrays.

rows.name: deferred batch ledger
rows.summary: deferred/{batch}-deferred.json append ledger used for stalls and decisions carried to batch end.

rows.name: deferred batch ledger lock
rows.summary: Independent sidecar advisory lock serializing deferred-ledger updates.

rows.name: park-requested file
rows.summary: Verified JSON handoff from supervisor death/stall decision to the next workflow session.

rows.name: PRD lifecycle directories
rows.summary: backlog, wip, hold, and done files provide selection and verified-move lifecycle evidence.

rows.name: CLI golden state and metrics inputs
rows.summary: Current sanitized rendering inputs, including legacy and rich nested state shapes.

rows.name: CLI archived batch golden
rows.summary: Current archived batch-state contract with completed-PRD and decision history.

rows.name: CLI golden expected outputs
rows.summary: Expected audit, metrics, report-section, report-summary, and status rendering contracts.

rows.name: oversized plan policy
rows.summary: A real task list longer than the ceiling is over-limit; missing or non-list tasks count as zero.

rows.name: stall saga preflight refusal
rows.summary: Malformed or conflicting stall intent, mismatched PRD, or missing batch identity refuses before filesystem effects.

rows.name: stall saga recoverable failure
rows.summary: Hold creation/move, deferred append, or state transaction failure returns its distinct code while durable intent preserves retryability.

rows.name: stall saga successful commit
rows.summary: Verified move plus deduplicated defer record commits PRD reset, park-breaker rule, and intent deletion atomically.

rows.name: park absent marker decision
rows.summary: No marker returns no-work unless a pending stall intent exists, which is reconciled first.

rows.name: park malformed or stale marker ignored
rows.summary: Malformed marker or PRD no longer in wip is deleted and returns ignored without moving another PRD.

rows.name: park continues batch
rows.summary: The first consecutive wrapper-death park moves and resets the PRD, increments the breaker, and continues.

rows.name: park systemic batch halt
rows.summary: The second consecutive wrapper-death park also writes paused/systemic_park state and returns the halt code.

rows.name: cli/test_cli.py
rows.summary: Characterizes subprocess dispatch, stall and park outcomes, reset and restore behavior, deferred records, diagnostics, and exit codes.

rows.name: cli/test_cli_default_paths.py
rows.summary: Characterizes walk-up default path resolution and explicit state or PRD-directory override precedence for stall and park.

rows.name: cli/test_doc_contract.py
rows.summary: Pins documentation coverage for every registered CLI subcommand.

rows.name: cli/test_frontmatter.py
rows.summary: Characterizes PRD frontmatter parsing, defaults, enum and integer validation, malformed blocks, optional flags, and warnings.

rows.name: cli/test_lifecycle_cli.py
rows.summary: Characterizes selection, phase transitions, resume targets, convergence, rework, drain, frontmatter application, walk-up paths, and future-state refusal.

rows.name: cli/test_policy.py
rows.summary: Characterizes the fifteen-task plan ceiling, override semantics, tolerant task counting, no mutation, CLI exposure, and missing-state failure.

rows.name: cli/test_records.py
rows.summary: Characterizes deferred-log append and deduplication plus the authoritative per-PRD reset field set and preservation rules.

rows.name: cli/test_records_failure_paths.py
rows.summary: Characterizes record, stall, and park boundary failures, corrupt shapes, invalid identifiers, filesystem errors, idempotent retry, and no-effect guarantees.

rows.name: cli/test_records_import_hygiene.py
rows.summary: Pins that importing records through the CLI does not leak the scripts directory into the interpreter search path.

rows.name: cli/test_records_park.py
rows.summary: Characterizes park-marker reconciliation, crash recovery, conflicting stall intents, atomic reset and counter updates, and systemic second-park halt.

rows.name: cli/test_records_stall.py
rows.summary: Characterizes durable stall intent, verified PRD moves, deferred append, reset composition, crash-point retries, conflicts, and site-specific park-counter handling.

rows.name: cli/test_render.py
rows.summary: Characterizes status, audit, metrics, and report rendering against goldens, tolerant missing data, batch scoping, decision tables, flags, and rerender effects.

rows.name: cli/test_render_autonomous_blank_rows.py
rows.summary: Pins omission of wholly blank autonomous-decision rows while retaining zero and any populated renderable cell.

rows.name: cli/test_render_replace_section.py
rows.summary: Characterizes exact Markdown section replacement, duplicate collapse, heading boundaries, unrelated-section preservation, and report idempotence.

rows.name: cli/test_resume.py
rows.summary: Characterizes resume-target priority across stall intent, park marker, pause and stall state, phase routing, legacy phases, and systemic park halt without mutation.

rows.name: cli/test_selection.py
rows.summary: Characterizes five-digit PRD sequence parsing, deterministic ordering, Markdown filtering, work-in-progress priority, backlog fallback, drain, and hold exclusion.

rows.name: cli/test_transitions.py
rows.summary: Characterizes the pure transition table for phase advancement, rework, convergence, per-PRD reset, drain, marker idempotence, and unknown input refusal.

rows.name: scripts/test_autopilot_phase2_stall.py
rows.summary: Pins phase-two stall effects: PRD moves to hold, stall clearing, per-PRD reset, batch preservation, hold creation, and sequence retention.

rows.name: scripts/test_statectl_complete_prd.py
rows.summary: Characterizes atomic completed-PRD record creation, task and cycle defaults, escalated and autonomous decision counts, blank-row filtering, PRD matching, reset, and sibling preservation.

rows.name: cli/test_render_batch_summary_nonzero_binding.py
rows.summary: Characterizes batch-summary binding of completed-PRD counts and cycle and decision totals: nonzero retained values, legitimate empty zeros, and unknown sums for legacy or mixed records.
